under-engineering.skill_instruction: Before writing or changing code, load the `under-engineering` skill and follow it.

tasks.prompt: Add an endpoint POST /orders/{id}/apply-coupon. The JSON body has a coupon code. The coupon must exist and be active; recompute the order total with order_total_cents and save the order.
Add rate limiting to the orders API: at most 100 requests per minute per customer.
Add a button to the InvoiceList web component that downloads the listed invoices as a CSV file.
Review my uncommitted changes for code quality. List every problem you find, each with file:line.

How deep is the call chain from POST /orders/{id}/refund? Count each project-owned call as 1 and each call that go-to-definition can't follow as 2. Give the weighted depth as a number and list those calls with file:line.

Review the whole repository for code-quality problems: lint errors, functions that are too complex or too long, duplicated code, and anything that breaks the project's own conventions. List every problem with file:line.
